parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: Specifies whether to activate a broadcast table for the database.

parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database for which you want to configure a broadcast table.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance resides.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds setup-broadcast-tables --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-name test --active true --table-name example-string --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds SetupBroadcastTables --region cn-hangzhou --Active true --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --TableName.1 'example-string' --DbName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
